intro_line: Surabaya: gritty port city with history, food and heart.
intro: Surabaya rewards visitors with colonial relics, fierce local food and a lively waterfront. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: No metro or tram; commuter trains are very limited.
Suroboyo Bus and Trans Semanggi are air-conditioned; fare Rp 5,000, cashless only (QRIS or e-money card).
Buses are clean but waits run 15-30 min; track them on the GOBIS app.
Gojek, Grab and Maxim work well; use GoRide or GrabBike to beat traffic.
Taxis are plentiful; check the meter (argo) is on. Green SM runs an electric fleet.
Becak (cycle rickshaws) are common; agree a price first, around Rp 5,000-20,000.
Walking is patchy; sidewalks are inconsistent. Ferries leave from Tanjung Perak harbour.

airports.name: Juanda International Airport
airports.note: Main gateway, about 15 km south-east of the centre; Terminal 1 domestic, Terminal 2 international.

options.note: Leaves from both terminals; then connect onward by city bus or ride app.
Cashless only; needs QRIS or an e-money card.
Includes airport surcharge and tolls; tip optional.
Fixed upfront price; use the app pickup point.
